title: HackHarbor
tagline: A hackathon site with a live countdown, 3D globe and registration
description: A complete event website for a 36-hour student hackathon, built from Junco's marketing blocks, motion effects and 3D scenes. It has a schedule by day, tracks, prizes, judges, an FAQ, and a validated registration form that ends with a toast and confetti.
features: Bold hero with a shader gradient and a live countdown
3D globe showing where hackers travel from
Schedule tabs, track cards with spotlight hover, prize and judge grids
Registration with React Hook Form + Zod, toast and confetti
Theme and motion switch, hash routing, works at 360px
